Planet Zybex

Controls

Follow the game's intro and menu prompts. Arrows move; Z fires. Choose Keyboard: Typing to enter text; switch back to Keyboard: Joystick to play. Gamepad and touch controls work in both modes. Escape leaves fullscreen.
